instruction: I'm watching lecture videos and want to take screenshots of important slides. The default screenshot location is inconvenient. Could you change VLC's video snapshot directory to save screenshots directly to my Desktop folder for easy access?

parameters.window_name: lecture.pdf — 6.006 Introduction to Algorithms, Lecture 2: Data Structures

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires user to set VLC's snapshot directory to Desktop (snapshot-path=/home/user/Desktop). The evaluator uses custom check_snapshot_path__f6cd7aaf metric to verify the setting in VLC config file.
metadata.verification: Verified with custom function check_snapshot_path__f6cd7aaf. Expected value: snapshot-path=/home/user/Desktop.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly reads VLC config file from OS-specific path (~/.config/vlc/vlcrc for Linux)
Metric logic correctly parses config file for 'snapshot-path=' setting and compares against expected value
Complete coverage: instruction requires changing snapshot directory to Desktop, evaluator checks VLC config has snapshot-path=/home/user/Desktop
Expected value (/home/user/Desktop) semantically correct for the task requirement
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config is persisted and readable
Runtime feasibility confirmed: getter can access config file, metric can parse text, error handling present
